units.spine: Almost nothing the Free Elder Council asks of Warmholz ever arrives, and nobody now troubles to chase down what is missing.
A stranger who takes a question to the Free Elder Council at Warmholz gets no answer, and the same question put to whoever happens to be standing nearby is settled before evening.

units.poolKey: no token matched: unclassified (the plain-description floor)
units.spine: The Free Elder Council holds the hall at Warmholz, and every matter of the town's business passes through it.

units.poolKey: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
units.spine: It may be that whatever threatens Warmholz comes from inside the hall rather than from outside it: the town pays badly and is watched worse. That combination is the cheapest kind of town to buy into, and worth watching for who tries.
The Free Elder Council at Warmholz reaches its decisions slowly, by general agreement, and rarely reverses one once it is made.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: A stranger at Warmholz who addresses the Free Elder Council by any other name is corrected on the spot, and without ceremony.
Warmholz is no longer sure the hall belongs to the Free Elder Council, and from the way it governs, neither is the Free Elder Council.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public rejection is breaking the hold
units.spine: What the Free Elder Council has lost at Warmholz it has lost to the town itself, and no rival was needed.
